description: Register a new resource or update an existing resource
title: Resource registration

type.description: Singular form of the resource type to be registered

data.description: Describes the Node and the services which run on it
data.title: Node resource

allOf.description: Describes the foundations of all NMOS resources
allOf.title: Base resource

id.description: Globally unique identifier for the resource

version.description: String formatted TAI timestamp (<seconds>:<nanoseconds>) indicating precisely when an attribute of the resource last changed

label.description: Freeform string label for the resource

tags.description: Key value set of freeform string tags to aid in filtering resources. Values should be represented as an array of strings. Can be empty.

href.description: HTTP access href for the Node's API (deprecated)

api.description: URL fragments required to connect to the Node API

versions.description: Supported API versions running on this Node

endpoints.description: Host, port and protocol details required to connect to the API

host.description: IP address or hostname which the Node API is running on

port.description: Port number which the Node API is running on

protocol.description: Protocol supported by this instance of the Node API

services.description: Array of objects containing a URN format type and href

href.description: URL to reach a service running on the Node

type.description: URN identifying the type of service

clocks.description: Clocks made available to Devices owned by this Node

anyOf.description: Describes a clock with no external reference
anyOf.title: Clock with no external reference

name.description: Name of this refclock (unique for this set of clocks)

ref_type.description: Type of external reference used by this clock

anyOf.description: Describes a clock referenced to PTP
anyOf.title: PTP clock

name.description: Name of this refclock (unique for this set of clocks)

ref_type.description: Type of external reference used by this clock

traceable.description: External refclock is synchronised to International Atomic Time (TAI)

version.description: Version of PTP reference used by this clock

gmid.description: ID of the PTP reference used by this clock

locked.description: Lock state of this clock to the external reference. If true, this device follows the external reference, otherwise it has no defined relationship to the external reference

interfaces.description: Network interfaces made available to devices owned by this Node. Port IDs and Chassis IDs are used to inform topology discovery via IS-06, and require that interfaces implement ARP at a minimum, and ideally LLDP.

chassis_id.description: Chassis ID of the interface, as signalled in LLDP from this node. Set to null where LLDP is unsuitable for use (ie. virtualised environments)

anyOf.description: When the Chassis ID is a MAC address, use this format
When the Chassis ID is anything other than a MAC address, a freeform string may be used
When the Chassis ID is unavailable it should be set to null

port_id.description: Port ID of the interface, as signalled in LLDP or via ARP responses from this node. Must be a MAC address

name.description: Name of the interface (unique in scope of this node).  This attribute is used by sub-resources of this node such as senders and receivers to refer to interfaces to which they are bound.

chassis_id.description: Chassis ID of the attached network device, as signalled in LLDP received by this Node.

anyOf.description: When the Chassis ID is a MAC address, use this format
When the Chassis ID is anything other than a MAC address, a freeform string may be used

port_id.description: Port ID of the attached network device, as signalled in LLDP received by this Node.

anyOf.description: When the Port ID is a MAC address, use this format
When the Port ID is anything other than a MAC address, a freeform string may be used

grain_rate.description: Number of Grains per second for this Flow. Must be an integer division of, or equal to the Grain rate specified by the parent Source. Grain rate matches the frame rate for video (see NMOS Content Model). Specified for periodic Flows only.

source_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the Source which initially created the Flow. This attribute is used to ensure referential integrity by registry implementations (v1.0 only).

device_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the Device which initially created the Flow. This attribute is used to ensure referential integrity by registry implementations (v1.1 onwards).

parents.description: Array of UUIDs representing the Flow IDs of Grains which came together to generate this Flow (may change over the lifetime of this Flow)

format.description: Format of the data coming from the Flow as a URN

frame_width.description: Width of the picture in pixels

frame_height.description: Height of the picture in pixels

interlace_mode.description: Interlaced video mode for frames in this Flow

colorspace.description: Colorspace used for the video. Any values not defined in the enum should be defined in the NMOS Parameter Registers

transfer_characteristic.description: Transfer characteristic. Any values not defined in the enum should be defined in the NMOS Parameter Registers

media_type.description: Subclassification of the format using IANA assigned media types

components.description: Array of objects describing the components

width.description: Width of this component in pixels

height.description: Height of this component in pixels

bit_depth.description: Number of bits used to describe each sample
